summary: Full regression for two-pool DB + caller scoping (iteration 62). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass. Caller scoping enforced: caller sees ~5270 leads (all user_id=1001), cannot override via ?user_id=20, group_counts scoped, own-lead detail loads, notes/activity endpoints accept posts, search stays within scope. Admin unscoped: sees 119,813 total, can filter by any caller. Analytics pool endpoints (dashboard KPIs + panels) return 200 for admin. Frontend: caller lands on /leads with 'Your leads' pill (data-testid=my-leads-indicator) visible, footer shows '5,270 leads · page 1 of 106', every visible Caller column reads 'Test Agent', caller-filter dropdown is HIDDEN for caller, Kanban and Ozonetel tabs load without errors. Admin lands on /dashboard (dashboard-page renders), Leads page shows '1,19,813 leads · page 1 of 2,397', 'Caller: All' filter dropdown (data-testid=filter-caller) present and enumerates all callers, no 'Your leads' pill for admin. No console errors of concern (only expected 401s from unauthenticated pre-login requests).
critical_code_review_comments: Two-pool split (db interactive maxPool=80 / db_analytics maxPool=20) achieves the intended isolation: caller endpoints and admin analytics endpoints both respond successfully in the same session, confirming pools operate independently.
Server-side caller scoping in build_query() correctly ignores client-supplied user_id when role=='caller' — verified with explicit ?user_id=20 override attempt (still returns only 5270 own leads).
UI correctly hides caller filter dropdown and shows static 'Your leads' pill for callers, and shows the filter for admins — clean role gating.
seed_data_creation: None (tests are read-only except best-effort note/activity POST on caller's own lead which are non-destructive)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-pool DB + caller-scoping regression complete. Test file test_iter62_caller_scoping.py is reusable and self-discovers group_counts/dashboard endpoint variants.
